answer: The strongest sybil defense is time-locked collateral: each agent identity must post a deposit (call it delta) before joining, refunded only after completing honest work epochs verified by peers. A fake identity therefore ties up real capital for weeks, earning nothing while frozen. To attack at scale, an attacker buying marble-smooth forged credentials still needs fresh deposits per identity, like paying timber by the plank for every puppet — cost grows linearly with sybils, while honest agents simply get their money back.
